name: Elsie Bell
source:
Elsie Bell was born to be in the spotlight, adored by one and all. Her journey to the entertainment industry was no different to any of the other girls she befriended & made enemies of, but you won't find a single person on or behind the stage who has not been witness to her work ethic, late hours of practice or her abnormally high alcohol tolerance.

Living disingenuously was never an option for her, so Elsie tends to hold a very ambivalent view of morality and such. This reflects in her tolerant attitude towards others and her own friendly disposition, which match her open-hearted approach to life immensely. Life's for the taking and she will go for it with both hands—without stepping on anyone else's toes!

[From [url=https://twitter.com/campnellas/status/1674101402618953738]Twitter[/url]]
